lines.text: Many learners say: I no like spicy food.
Better: I don't like spicy food.

native.tip: Kita bilang “saya tidak suka” atau “nggak suka”. Di bahasa Inggris, “tidak” sebelum kata kerja adalah don't, bukan no.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I no like spicy food.” 😅 Sebelum kata kerja, pakai don't: “I don't like spicy food.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “don't”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I don't like spicy food.” lalu tulis satu makanan yang tidak kamu suka. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “saya tidak suka”. In English, “tidak” before a verb is don't, not no.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I no like spicy food.” 😅 Before a verb, use don't: “I don't like spicy food.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
